definitions.explanation: The destination to which mail, email, data, or phone calls are redirected from the original address or number.

examples.japanese: {転送先|てんそうさき}を{設定|せってい}する。
メールの{転送先|てんそうさき}を{変更|へんこう}してください。
examples.english: Please change the email forwarding destination.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{際|さい}に{郵便物|ゆうびんぶつ}の{転送先|てんそうさき}を{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: When moving, I submitted a forwarding address for my mail.

notes:
A compound of {転送|てんそう} (forwarding; transfer) and {先|さき} (destination). Used in both digital contexts (email forwarding, call forwarding, data transfer) and physical contexts (mail forwarding after moving).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転送先|てんそうさき}を{設定|せってい}する: to set a forwarding destination
- {転送先|てんそうさき}を{変更|へんこう}する: to change the forwarding destination
- {転送先|てんそうさき}アドレス: forwarding address
- {電話|でんわ}の{転送先|てんそうさき}: call forwarding destination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {送付先|そうふさき}: delivery destination — where something is sent to (not redirected)
- {宛先|あてさき}: addressee; destination address — the intended recipient
- {転居先|てんきょさき}: new address (after moving) — specifically about a residential address change
